card.name: Words just before political actors appear
card.fires_on: Small linking words, commas and verbs in policy or public-affairs prose, right where a government body or political actor (Congress, administration, states, we) is about to be named.

modes.label: Verb before Congress or states
modes.description: A verb like led or caused follows a social problem, and a legislature or government is the next word.
modes.example: However, high costs<< led>> Congress, beginning in 198

modes.label: Comma or preposition before political actor
modes.description: A comma, "by", "of" or "from" follows a policy clause, and a government actor or political theme comes next.
modes.example: But instead of fixing the problem<<,>> the Bush administration has been attempting to expand

card.writes: It pushes the model toward predicting the word political and its relatives in several languages.
card.plain: It fires on small words in news or policy writing just before the text turns to government or politics.
